      "observations": [
        "The manifest registers a new test. The test source blob is identical at the original and fixed accepted revisions: 1bc0bc2939d5e6a319727bf9db0c252c504b6968. Its full 277-line body was inspected once, then reused by exact identity.",
        "The extension registers event listeners before the UI action. Four indexed runs create a contact, move it to the test address book and delete it. A Set must contain eight unique IDs. The create and move results are compared with contacts.get using strict deep comparison.",
        "The move promise waits for both onCreated and onDeleted and checks the destination parent, old contact ID and old parent. It does not assert which event arrives first. It never queries the old ID after the move and does not directly assert stale-ID lookup rejection or absence of duplicate callbacks.",
        "The accepted edit-contact caller creates the destination card with addCard(card, true), then deletes the old card. The existing production lesson covers that contract. This test adds direct event and cache-result checks, rather than another production change.",
        "The lazy panel getter inserts the template into the DOM, so the test accesses the getter before disabling animation. Popup waits use actual panel state. The fixture selects address-book index 1, while the event parent-ID assertion checks the chosen destination.",
        "Two new Assert.notEqual calls at test lines 230 and 255 have no message. Their nearby comments are not assertion messages. The checked shared deep-comparison helper also calls its nested helper without forwarding the description at line 16, so null/undefined branches can receive an absent message; that helper is unchanged dependency scope, not a new defect in this patch.",
        "The test uses a local prompt mock and registers restoration of that mock and panel animation. Account/address-book harness cleanup was not traced further. The separate Bug1742904 steps remain a bounded unread locator.",
        "The exact primary Bug2003092 description and comments 0–2 plus footer were read. The description has no details; the author points to Bug1742904 steps. That dependency remains a locator and is not reconstructed from this test. The primary records landing 8657bd4f1d2d.",
        "The own D275698 summary and complete creation-to-final timeline were read. It has zero actual inlines and no summary edits. A lint defect/failed build is followed by updates and later remote build completions; human approval precedes a final later update. No submitted human request changes the cache contract, and approval/build labels are not fresh test evidence.",
        "The direct source checks remain narrower than the title: the test checks new IDs, both move event objects, new-ID contacts.get results and repeated create/move/delete cycles. It does not assert event order, old-ID lookup rejection or no duplicate callbacks. The two new message-less Assert.notEqual calls remain explicit despite acceptance."

      "observations": [
        "All 10 owned paths and every changed test hunk were inspected. The header no longer adds a separate picker th. Each ordinary cell creates its own picker button, #updateView marks the last visible column and CSS exposes only that button outside dragging/move transitions. The row-level colspan workaround and the dedicated TreeViewTableColumnPicker class are removed.",
        "The header owns one popup appended to the outer tree-view container. It rebuilds menu items on popupshowing from the current column order, preserves disabled picker:false items and adds restore/template items. Header cells can be rebuilt with replaceChildren because the menu is no longer their descendant. The older keep-the-extra-picker-cell-alive implementation is historical, not the new DOM contract.",
        "Click and context-menu handling is delegated to the header. The opening handlers check table.editable; picker button creation is unconditional. This proves the open guard, not every visual or keyboard state of a noneditable table. The checked disconnectedCallback only disconnects the resize observer; independent header removal while its outer tree survives was not traced, so no leak is claimed.",
        "The initial picker constructor omits the old document.l10n.setAttributes call and the default tab-index assignment. Accepted source later has both. The immediately following 4261 owns the tabIndex = -1 change only; the later label restoration is not credited to either original source audit. Source evidence is separate from a live accessible-name or keyboard test.",
        "The auto-tree test changes its header count from seven to six and excludes picker buttons when checking ordinary labels. Callers now find the last-column button and the popup under the outer tree. Changed keyboard checks assert picker focus, Enter opening without a new message tab, Escape hiding and header context-menu opening. The double-click test checks that the current tab remains unchanged.",
        "The negative keyboard focus assertion still queries th[is=\"tree-view-table-column-picker\"] button at accepted test lines 315–320. That custom header-cell class is removed by the owned migration. The selector therefore no longer identifies the generated picker, and the not-equal assertion can compare the active element with null instead of proving picker blur. This is a static coverage weakness, not an executed failure.",
        "The changed header-count assertion has no message. The inspected auto-tree label/visibility helper assertions and the address-book helper's disabled-item assertion also lack messages. The changed positive keyboard assertion has a concrete should message. No missing should alone is treated as a defect in historical messages.",
        "The fixture replaces direct children.push calls with TreeDataRow.appendRow, which assigns the parent and child level as well as appending. Later accepted fixture code no longer creates those Australia children; the parent/level helper contract remains checked separately. Shorter mock header text removes a documented old drag workaround without proving all drag locations were tested.",
        "Translation animation moves from a JS duration constant and matchMedia check to a CSS class under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference. Drag end removes the class; last-column/dragging splitters are hidden. Two icon rules now target the ordinary header button rather than every image in the cell, so they do not also select the new picker image.",
        "The transition comment correctly changes Y to X, but its element type still names a table row while callers pass header cells. headerColumns returns querySelectorAll despite an Array return annotation. The popup-outside-table and submenu guard comments describe actual ownership/conditions. These are local documentation facts and gaps, not a global naming or comment template.",
        "The original full Bug2001258 description/comments 0–7 and real footer were read once for this pair and reused by exact ID. The author reports an extra announced column from the old extra header cell/row colspan design. The earlier ARIA level/position patch and its remaining VoiceOver limitation are separate. Two other remaining issues are moved to unread Bug2049997; this patch is not credited with solving the whole accessibility report.",
        "The full D276128 summary and creation-to-final timeline plus its one actual inline were read. The reviewer acknowledges transferring animation to CSS and removes design review because these CSS changes are functional. This is scoped feedback on this patch, not a general design-review exemption or a verified accessibility outcome.",
        "The actual source moves the animation class into reduced-motion-aware CSS and moves the popup outside rebuilt header rows. The complete primary records original landing 1d807e7e7de3 followed by the distinct tab-index fix d9321bd30183. No fresh screen-reader, keyboard or drag run is implied by acceptance or remote build completion. The stale negative selector and assertion-message limits remain."
